description: Full-text search over G2's software product catalog. Returns matching products with name, slug, rating, review count, and description. Brand-name queries (e.g. 'slack') return detailed results with descriptions; category-style queries (e.g. 'project management') return products listed in that category. Results are returned in a single page.
